title: Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition 2026.11.09.4
notes:
- The Playlist nudges right after you place a clip or drop audio near the visible right edge, including on successive placements. This uses the existing scroll range and keeps your current zoom.
- Restored the previous horizontal scrollbar behavior in the Playlist and Piano Roll.
- Fixed cases where applying Audio Timing failed to attach the rendered audio. Audio Timing and Vocal Tuning now show activity while processing.
- Audio Timing asks before baking vocal tuning into the warped audio. Choose Don't show again to save your preference, or restore the warning in Settings > General > Hints and warnings > Manage messages.
- Fixed the Channel Rack Swing control and gave the add-channel button its own space in the FL Studio 2005 theme.

https://michaellanemusic.de/lemon-studio/
